purpose: Explain meaning-preserving English writing transformations and word choice in the existing app.
selection: Retain the 31 inspectable curriculum concepts; improve depth, boundaries and provenance before adding volume. Domain contexts are writing examples, not specialist advice.
origin: Existing project curriculum revised with AI assistance; independent examples authored for this release.
source_policy: Reference URLs support named principles only. No full external lessons or scraped exercise collections are redistributed.
example_policy: Three original positive examples and one counterexample per concept; optional exact canonical drill adaptation.
evaluation_policy: All supplied sets are development or challenge data, not independently held-out data. Canonical fixture IDs must match full source fields; synthetic IDs use eval_.
exclusions: claims of CEFR certification or measured learning gains
